note: Adapted from Scheffrahn 2018; original in English; the alate measurements (Table 1 of the original) survive in the extracted text only as the Neotermes costaseca column, the values for this species being missing, so they are not recorded; the soldier measurements are taken from the Neotermes chilensis column of Table 2 of the original (n=10, mean and range).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and pronotum red-brown. Anterior margin of the compound eyes straight; ocelli yellow-orange and kidney-shaped, abutting the margin of the compound eyes. The two vertices of the head and the anterior frons slightly depressed and slightly wrinkled, with sparse short hairs (0.15—0.2 mm), the hairs of the head directed forwards, those of the pronotum pointing in no fixed direction. Pronotum wider than the head capsule; anterior margin evenly concave, the middle of the anterior margin notched, the whole bow-tie shaped; dorsum with short and medium-length hairs (0.15—0.25 mm). Anterior margin of the fore wing scale convex, with a marginal row of 15—20 equally long hairs. Arolium absent.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Dorsum and sides of the head capsule orange-brown, the venter paler; pronotum yellow-orange. Eye spot dark, small and oval. Head and pronotum with short hairs (0.1—0.15 mm), the hairs of the frontal lobes denser and longer. Sides of the head capsule parallel, narrowing anteriorly to about 85% of the width; genal horns projecting on the venter. Frons gently sloping at about 30° from the vertex, depressed from the level of the postclypeus to the middle of the vertex. Pronotum crescent-shaped, the posterior margin evenly rounded and reaching the anterolateral angles. Antennae 14—18-segmented, relative length of the basal segments 1 > 2 < 3 > 4. Mandibles with a stout basal process at about 3/4 of the distance from the tip, bending abruptly by about 90° at about 1/4 from the tip; dentition stout and undulate. Measurements (mm, n=10, mean (range)): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 3.25 (2.80—3.84); greatest head width 2.63 (2.31—2.97); head height (including the postmentum) 1.94 (1.75—2.13); pronotum length 1.54 (1.25—1.84), width 2.74 (2.38—3.19); antennal segment count 16.22 (14—18); length of antennal segment 3 0.23 (0.19—0.28).
